CanTxPayload.description: 8-byte CAN payload buffer built by can_get_tx_payload_for_id: three little-endian words (u16, u32, u16). The bytes are CAN data bytes 0..7 in order.

fields.name: word0
fields.description: Data bytes 0..1 of the frame (little-endian), from the first source value of the identifier.

fields.name: word1
fields.description: Data bytes 2..5 of the frame (little-endian), usually two or three packed source values.

fields.name: word2
fields.description: Data bytes 6..7 of the frame (little-endian), from the last source value; zero for identifiers that send no third word.

ProtoTpBlock.description: Callback block of the J1939 transport-protocol session table. Only the callback words at +0x00 and +0x0C are used in this packet.

fields.name: accept_callback
fields.description: Accept callback word (probably the receive-side hook). Must be nonzero for proto_sessions_init to publish the session table.

fields.name: tx_callback
fields.description: Transmit callback used by vcu_can_tp_sender_tick to send each TP frame (RTS, DT, EOM).
